Original is37e809ead5824bc753a1c3d56f11615bdb1296c5; observed default isae89581dfd24c6277b4267a9779d05f7b9f047f1. Exact reported-span/unique-snippet guards, containing type, method token identity and owning emitter-literal checks are required on both revisions. The independent audit additionally recomputes exact complete method text from physical source line ranges and matches it literally in the actual generator source.

Four snapshots repeat generated boilerplate from one actual output template. That is source identity, not proof that complete fixtures/apps are equivalent. Different cards/snippets in the same method remain distinct. F304 failed reported-span acceptance and remains pending; F306 is only the lowest verified member of its group.

The syntax tool actually compiled and executed; this is untimed source analysis, not a product test or benchmark. Canonical reachability, compatible implementations and gains remain unverified. No canonical budget was consumed/closed and no extra confidence is manufactured from repeated snapshots.

No shipping source/config, permanent test, source PR or browser launch. Fixed classified report unchanged. Immutable evidence predates the additive publication receipt and live campaign-index update.

[Additive verified publication receipt](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/autoperf-results/OpenApiXmlCommentAliases/publication.json). All113 immutable core files remain unchanged. Nineteen duplicate closures are not nineteen fixes or measured improvements.

actualDecision.limits: Exact generated-method/source-emitter identity only. Distinct test fixtures remain valuable. This does not measure frequency, equivalence of complete generated assemblies, whole-app impact, fixes, allocation or speed. Twelve records failed strict mapping and remain pending, including F304; F306 is only the lowest verified member of its two-record group.
